## Summary

Describe the problem and the observable result of this change.

## Validation

List the exact commands or evidence used to validate the result.

## Change impact

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or this change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Directly affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] Package boundaries and dependency direction remain valid.
- [ ] Public API, compatibility, migration, and SemVer effects are documented.
- [ ] Release or deployment effects are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, customer data, or private endpoints are included.
- [ ] I have read and agree to follow the Code of Conduct.
